notes.title: Summer Update
notes.notes:
Following the recent release of the third game in the Blocks! collection, Hammer of the Scots, we have updated [b]Julius Caesar[/b] with the improvements brought in the last product.

Those mostly concern improvements of the multiplayer engine.
Also, we have added improvements to the retreat procedures.

Work is going on, thanks to the current ongoing early access campaign, on the other engine features that are still in demand, and that will be ported back into this game when completed.

Visit the Hammer game here : [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1201310/Blocks_Hammer_of_the_Scots/]Hammer of the Scots Early Access[/url]

notes.title: January Update
notes.notes:
[MULTIPLAYER] Fix game occasionally stuck on Battle Retreat phase ("Retreat from Pool" message)

[WINTER TURN] Fix game occasionally stuck at Winter Turn. Occurred when 4 or more navies had to return to ports.

[BUG] Fix three cards in the deck wrongly doubling the Levy points given for a turn

[INPUT] Add Page Up/Down keys as zooming alternative

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.notes:
To start off the new year, you'll find your Julius Caesar version updated with some corrections. Enjoy!

[u]Patch Notes[/u]
[MULTIPLAYER] Fix game occasionally stuck on Battle Retreat phase ("Retreat from Pool" message)
[WINTER TURN] Fix game occasionally stuck at Winter Turn. Occurred when [i]4 or more[/i] navies had to return to ports.
[BUG] Fix three cards in the deck wrongly doubling the Levy points given for a turn
[INPUT] Add Page Up/Down keys as zooming alternative

For Richard III owners: note that the Multiplayer fix has been pushed in that game too.

[i]Stumbling onto a problem? Don't hesitate to send us a word at [url=support@avalon-digital.com]support@avalon-digital.com[/url] describing your issue.
Whenever applicable, please join to it your game save, available both for single and multi player in the folder C:/Users/[user_name]/AppData/LocalLow/Avalon Digital/Blocks! Julius Caesar (Windows)[/i]

notes.title: Release of Julius Caesar
notes.notes:
This game is the second adaptation of the famous Columbia Games blocks games, on the new [b]Blocks![/b] engine. 

After the previous opus located in Medieval Britain, you now travel back in time and are ready to fight with Caesar and Pompey in a grand strategy epic of the infamous Roman Civil War.

As Julius said then, [i]Veni Vidi Vici[/i] (I came I saw I vanquished)...yours to discover now
